units.summary: CompactStaleHead now uses the shared compactHeadViewLocked helper. Stale series are read through NewSelectedSeriesHead instead of NewStaleHead. Eviction is now gated on an append-ID watermark taken from committedAppendID before blocks are written. Each chunk range gets a fresh BlockMeta, and ranges that produce no block skip reloadBlocks.
units.headline: Stale-head compaction moved onto shared view helper with append-ID eviction guard
units.reason: Changes how blocks are written and which series are evicted, which affects data persistence and WAL truncation.
focus: Block bounds now come from view.Meta().MinTime and MaxTime+1 instead of staleHead.MinTime() and BlockMaxTime(); confirm they match
CompactStaleHead still holds db.cmtx before calling compactHeadViewLocked
Series that get new samples after the watermark are kept in the head, not evicted
The doc on truncateStaleSeries says lastAppendID, but the caller passes committedAppendID

units.summary: Blocks tagged with the from-selected-series hint no longer count towards the in-order max time. That value is the cutoff for WAL replay and head truncation, so a block holding only a subset of series can no longer push the cutoff past WAL-only data.
units.headline: inOrderBlocksMaxTime now ignores from-selected-series blocks
units.reason: Changes the WAL-replay and head-truncation cutoff, which directly affects data retention.
focus: Every path that writes selected-series blocks sets the hint, and merging keeps it (plan and CompactBlockMetas)

units.summary: Removes TestStaleBlockNotMergedWithNonStaleBlock and TestOutOfOrderBlockMergePreservesHint from this spot in the file. Both are re-added later in the file with the same bodies, and only their doc comments change, so no test coverage is lost.
